dataset_name: Lac de Vassivière - bathymetric survey reference

source_survey.survey_method: Multibeam echosounder (Kongsberg EM3002) + vessel mounted LiDAR
source_survey.horizontal_reference: Local geodetic network / French geodetic reference systems

important_limitation: This package contains the published nautical chart and the source report, not the original multibeam sounding/DTM dataset. The original survey data were delivered to EDF and the lake authorities according to the publication.

application_model.zeroing: If the current water level is known, use it directly. Otherwise, calibrate an offset against a measured sonar depth at a known position or against a reliable lake-level reference.
